findings.title: Generated release status accepted ledger entries without recomputing their self-digests
findings.reproduction: Alter the last ledger result summary while preserving its existing entry_sha256; the prior status validator accepted the entry when chain links remained shaped correctly.
findings.resolution: Recompute canonical SHA-256 for every entry before rendering status and reject stale digests.

findings.title: The compact release-gate checkpoint was not mechanically bound to the retained raw proof and logs
findings.reproduction: A syntactically valid count or digest could be changed in the compact checkpoint without a derivation check against raw pass records and hash-bound logs.
findings.resolution: Add strict checkpoint validation plus optional full derivation of file/canonical hashes, external inputs, step records, logs, metrics, tools, artifacts, and cross-pass identities.

findings.title: Pre-commit used stale isolated Ruff/Mypy environments and a mutating lint command
findings.reproduction: The all-files hook rewrote 93 untouched files, then failed on stale Ruff rules and 700 Mypy errors caused by missing project dependencies.
findings.resolution: Use non-mutating lint/format/type commands from the frozen project environment with the same typed scope as the release gate.

rejected_hypotheses.hypothesis: SSE/media query tokens leak through production HTTP access logs
rejected_hypotheses.reason: The production Uvicorn configuration disables access logging; a regression now pins access_log=false. Tokens are ephemeral, loopback-only, and required because EventSource/media elements cannot attach the custom header.

rejected_hypotheses.hypothesis: The Resolve development self-test eval exposes a shipped code-injection surface
rejected_hypotheses.reason: The eval exists only in the developer shell self-test, receives fixed in-script property expressions, and is absent from the staged plugin and production engine.

rejected_hypotheses.hypothesis: The release-gate 0777 container smoke directory grants a shipped privilege
rejected_hypotheses.reason: The mode applies only to a disposable ignored host bind directory so the pinned non-root container user can write a smoke output; it is neither packaged nor installed.
